This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Unidentified-Wide-Mouthed-Species-Running.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A member of this species running down the streets of Canto Bight]]
In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="TLJ Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. ''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'' takes place immediately after the end of ''The Force Awakens''.</ref> a member of this species was chased down the streets near [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in [[Canto Bight]] on [[Cantonica]] by [[Resistance]] agents [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] on [[fathier]]-back.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[2017]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi]]'', directed by [[Rian Johnson]].<ref name="TLJ" /> They referred to by the production code "King 54" or "K054 species" on set. According to Keeper of the Holocron, [[Leland Chee]], the creature costume for this species was available for one of the live action series, though he did not specify which show and was unsure if it was actually ever used.<ref name="Production Codes">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-03|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1357390166767046817|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-TLJ-Recycled-Aliens.png}}</ref> As of [[April 1]], [[2025]], this species still did not have a name within [[Holocron continuity database]].<ref name="Unnamed Aliens">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1356720840036847656|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Unnamed-Species-TLJ.png}}</ref>
